--- review/greptile-triage.md ---
# Greptile Comment Triage
Both `/review` (Step 2.5) and `/ship` (Step 10) reference this document.
REMOTE_SLUG=$(browse/bin/remote-slug 2>/dev/null || ~/.claude/skills/gstack/browse/bin/remote-slug 2>/dev/null || basename "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)")
GREPTILE_PROJECT_LOG="$HOME/.gstack/projects/$REMOTE_SLUG/greptile-history.md"   # per-project, used for suppressions
GREPTILE_GLOBAL_LOG="$HOME/.gstack/greptile-history.md"                          # global aggregate, read by /retro
mkdir -p "$HOME/.gstack/projects/$REMOTE_SLUG"
Append one line per triage outcome to BOTH "$GREPTILE_PROJECT_LOG" and "$GREPTILE_GLOBAL_LOG" (greptile-history.md).
Suppressions Check reads "$GREPTILE_PROJECT_LOG" only.
